_doc: The living half of this page. The card's address is burned in and can never change, so this page is the only place anything new can land. Adding an entry is a JSON edit and a deploy — never a new page and never a new URL. Newest first. This file arrived 2026-08-16, the day a build gate started refusing any page a card points at that has no way to change.

entries.es: Esta página no podía cambiar hasta hoy
entries._withheld_en: This page could not change until today
entries.body_es: La dirección en la tarjeta es fija, así que esta página es el único lugar donde algo nuevo puede aparecer. No tenía bitácora hasta hoy — ya la tiene, y esta es su primera entrada.
entries._withheld_body_en: The address on the card is fixed, so this page is the only place anything new can ever land. It had no logbook until today — now it does, and this is its first entry.
entries._audit_body_en: Same measurement as the other four frozen pages, 2026-08-16: no marker, no entries.json, no .entry CSS, 200 on every sweep. The build gate in tools/build_site.py now forces the living half to exist for any page a card's resolves_to names inside this site.
entries._withheld_why: src/site/nica/index.html declares, in Spanish, that this page carries no English. The renderer renders body_en whenever it exists, so the fields are withheld here rather than deleted. Restore by removing the _withheld_ prefix.
